    def productExceptSelf(self, nums: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        answer = [1] * n

        prefix = 1
        for i in range(n):

            prefix *= nums[i]
            print("prefix pass", i, answer)

        for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
